subject: Savanna Example Air
cases.text: NAIROBI, 20 October 2026 — Savanna Example Air has appointed Grace Achieng as Head of Cargo, effective 1 January 2027, succeeding Peter Mwangi, who retires after 12 years.

subject: Savanna Example Air
cases.text: The Head of Cargo will chair the evaluation panel. Daniel Mwangi attended the briefing in Nairobi on behalf of the airline.

subject: Example Air
cases.text: Example Air thanked its customers. Speaking at the event, Lucy Njeri, Managing Director of Blue Ridge Handling, said capacity would rise.

subject: Savanna Example Air
cases.text: "We look forward to growing exports together," said John Lee, Chief Executive Officer of Blue Ridge Handling, Savanna Example Air's ground handling partner.

subject: Savanna Example Air
cases.text: Savanna Example Air's Chief Commercial Officer Amina Yusuf said the deal covers Nairobi.

subject: Example Air
cases.text: Jane Wairimu, former Cargo Sales Manager at Example Air, joined Blue Ridge Handling as Commercial Director in 2025.

subject: Kenya Civil Aviation Authority

subject: Savanna Example Air
cases.text: The Kenya Civil Aviation Authority and Savanna Example Air signed the agreement. Present were Ruth Wanjiku, Director General of the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority, and Samuel Otieno, Procurement Manager.

subject: Savanna Example Air
